title: TSAI VP-JWT Claims Set
description: JWT Claims Set for a TSAI VP-JWT (VC-JOSE-COSE encoding).

iss.description: Agent DID (must match credentialSubject.id in enclosed VC)

aud.description: Service Provider identifier. HTTP: request URL origin. MCP stdio: server identifier. Push notifications: webhook URL origin.

iat.description: Issued-at (Unix timestamp). Service Providers MUST validate within ±30 seconds of current time.

exp.description: Expiration (Unix timestamp). MUST be no more than 60 seconds after iat.

nonce.description: Nonce provided by the Service Provider. OPTIONAL for T0/T1, REQUIRED for T2/T3. Eliminates replay window when present.

_extensibility_note.description: additionalProperties is false for TSAI 1.0 strictness. Future versions may relax this to allow extension claims.
